maxLeases.description: Maximum number of leases to acquire

target.description:
The specific resource requesting leases. Required: leases are scoped to a
single target, so callers must identify which resource they're polling for.

resourceId.description: The resource ID within the deployment's stack (e.g. a Worker/Container/Daemon id).

resourceType.description: The kind of resource `resource_id` refers to.

waitSeconds.description:
How long the server may hold this request open when no command is
queued yet, in seconds (0 to 25, default 0). A waiting request is
answered as soon as a command for the target is queued. The server
caps the value at 25 and at the caller's credential lifetime; a server
that does not support waiting answers at once.
